  > 
  > Per-claim verdicts with numbers, uncertainty and scope are in `experiment-repo`#4 (read the follow-up correction on mechanism (d), it changes what the text may say about real graphs). Headlines: C1 slopes −0.50 / +0.55 / −0.50 (predicted −½ / +½ / −½); C2 exact bias prediction inside the MC interval in 82% of cells, bias independent of d only for (c), (e), (f); C3 variance minimised at p = ½ in all slices; C4 regression wins in 78% of grid cells at σ = 0.5 (31% at σ = 4), threshold mechanism (d) is the exception on synthetic graphs at d ≥ 20; C5 mixed; **C6 data-computable diagnostic not supported** (only part (i) on D* passes); **C8 nominal coverage not achieved** (mean 0.745, driven by |bias|/SD, not by L). Report C6 and C8 as negative results.
  > 
  > Where each number is computed (state the function, not a plan): errors, variance split and leverage in `code/src/gate/sim.py` and `analysis/agg.py`; cell metrics and coverage `analysis/make_cells.py`; ratios to DM with the paired two-level bootstrap `make_cells.py`; exact bias prediction `predict_bias.py`; diagnostic, D* and acceptance `make_diag.py`; claim reductions `claims.py` (docstrings give the definitions); script→table map in REPRODUCE.md §5. Each result's scope: synthetic outcomes from mechanisms (a)–(f), σ ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 1} planned and {2, 4} extension, synthetic 10 graphs × 300 assignments, real graphs 1 × 3000, Tier A 200 draws per graph at σ = 0.5, cluster designs at γ = 1, 3 and planted partition only (γ = 0.3 is degenerate on synthetic graphs). Tell me any number the text still lacks.
